A M Custom Effects browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal A M Custom Effects Metal Maniac - Mega Distortion Published on May 16, 2010 A M Custom Effects distortion pedal Information A&M Custom Effects Metal Maniac is Custom Hand Made, 100% analog guitar High Gain distortion pedal. This pedal made specially for differents hard metal music styles,and have unbelievable powerful High Gain distortion sound. Specifications: Durable Silver polychromatic diecast aluminum enclosure, IPV5 standard Pedal Dimensions 119x94x34mm (4.67"x3.68"x1.18") Black colour pinter knobs Red ultrabright 5mm LEDs with wide view angle Chrome LED sockets True Bypass Tube like Tone. More Gain than you would ever need.
